title: Payment outage review
segments: Alex
Let's review Monday's payment outage. Checkout failed for 47 minutes, from 9:12 to 9:59 in the morning.
Alex
We estimate around 2,300 failed orders, roughly 95 thousand dollars in delayed revenue.
Jordan
The trigger was an expired TLS certificate on the connection to our payment provider. It expired at 9:12 exactly.
Jordan
The certificate was installed manually two years ago, so it wasn't covered by our automatic renewal.
Kim
Our monitoring caught the error spike within three minutes, but the error message said 'connection reset', which sent us looking at the network first.
Alex
So most of the 47 minutes was diagnosis, not the fix itself?
Kim
Right. Once we saw the certificate, replacing it took about eight minutes.
Alex
Action items. First, move every certificate to automated renewal and inventory all manual ones. Jordan, can you own that by end of next week?
Jordan
Yes. I'll also add an alert thirty days before any certificate expires.
Kim
I'd like to improve the error logging so TLS handshake failures are labeled clearly instead of 'connection reset'.
Alex
Good, Kim takes the logging change. Also, customers whose orders failed should get an email with a ten percent discount code.
Jordan
Support should handle that. Do we retry the failed orders automatically?
Alex
No automatic retries, some customers already re-ordered. We'll only send the email. I'll brief the support team today.
Kim
Should we write a public status page update?
Alex
Yes, a short postmortem on the status page by Thursday. I'll draft it and Jordan reviews.

key_points.point: Root cause: expired TLS certificate installed manually, not auto-renewed
Misleading 'connection reset' error slowed diagnosis; fix took ~8 minutes
Automate certificate renewal + inventory; alert 30 days before expiry
Customers get email with 10% discount; no automatic retries
Public postmortem on status page by Thursday

action_items.text: Jordan moves certificates to automated renewal by end of next week
Alex drafts status page postmortem by Thursday
